3 am ramblings

i wrote this in the most self hating state ever wanting to change but i woke up the next day losing the reason to do so

My Body is a machine

i have been on a decline for a long period only going downhill been in a mental battle with myself and in this battle i lost .. a lot i can’t let myself go back there anymore My Body is a machine that i need to keep busy My mind is a monster that is hungry for thoughts i need to keep both busy My heart is a faint kid that i need to let go of i can’t let it take control of me again My body is a machine

i need to get stronger , lift weights i need to get smarter , study more i need to feel less , stay busy i need to express more , create more

My body is a machine that has a brain that needs to be shut i no longer deserve or have the luxury to ruminate or overthink
i no longer have the luxury of time and quality of life that gives me the permission to think beyond what i see, experience and sense no more assumptions no more thinking ahead of every possible scenario no more OVER thinking

My body is a machine that if i don’t use to my benefit it’s gonna kill me

My body is a machine That will help me achieve all the things i want and feel what i always longed for

My heart needs to stop My heart is not a machine it’s a delicate fragile relic i can’t let it on display all the time My heart needs to stop

My body is a machine from now onward just moves forward performs action gets stuff done and doesn’t question anything

My body is a machine that didn’t find what it wanted or felt what it needed so it turned into a machine

My body is a machine That will make me feel happy and get me what i want and help me feel everything i couldn’t feel right now

My body is a machine that will make it possible …
